info.title: ORBTR API
info.description: api.orbtr.ai's /v1 inference surface, as its handlers serve it.

post.summary: Send a message and receive the reply.
Count a request's input tokens without sending it.

get.summary: List the models a call may name.

post.summary: Cancel a message batch's unfinished requests.

get.summary: Fetch a batch's results, one per request.

ImageSource.description: Where an image block's bytes come from.

type.description: base64 for inline data, url for a fetched image.

media_type.description: The image's media type, such as image/png.

data.description: The base64-encoded bytes, when type is base64.

url.description: The image's address, when type is url.

ContentBlockParam.description: One block of a message's content.

text.description: The text of a text block.

tool_use_id.description: The tool_use block a tool_result answers.

is_error.description: Whether a tool_result reports a failure.

TextBlockParam.description: A text block of a system prompt.

MessageParam.description: One message of the conversation sent.

content.description: The message's text, or its blocks.

ToolParam.description: A tool the model may call.

input_schema.description: The JSON Schema of the tool's input.

ToolChoice.description: How the model chooses a tool.

type.description: auto lets the model decide, any requires a tool, tool requires the named one, none forbids tools.

name.description: The tool to call, when type is tool.

model.description: A model id from GET /v1/models, or a published flow's id, optionally pinned as <flow id>@<version>.

max_tokens.description: The most tokens the reply may hold.

stream.description: Whether the reply arrives as server-sent events.

top_k.description: Sample from the k most likely tokens.

stop_sequences.description: Text that ends the reply when generated.

depth_tier.description: How deeply ORBTR's recurrent models think.

max_loops.description: The most reasoning loops an adaptive turn may run.

max_ot.description: The most OT the whole turn may spend; 0 leaves it uncapped.

on_max_ot_hit.description: What a turn that reaches max_ot answers: partial returns the work done, error refuses.

MessageCountTokensParams.description: The body of POST /v1/messages/count_tokens: the request to count.

ContentBlock.description: One block of a reply's content.

type.description: The block's kind: text, tool_use or tool_result.

text.description: The text of a text block.

tool_use_id.description: The tool_use block a tool_result answers.

is_error.description: Whether a tool_result reports a failure.

FlowStepUsage.description: One step of a flow run's usage.

stepId.description: The step's id in the flow.

modelId.description: The model the step named, when it named one.

calls.description: The model or assistant calls the step made.

FlowRunUsage.description: The usage of a flow called as a model: the version that answered, the run and each step.

steps.description: One line per step; the lines sum to totalOt.

Usage.description: Tokens and OT a reply used.

cached_input_ot.description: The OT charged for cached input.

fresh_input_ot.description: The OT charged for fresh input.

ot_breakdown.description: The OT charged, line by line.

display_money_micros.description: The money amount, in millionths of the display currency.

reservation_id.description: The OT reservation the call settled.

loops_consumed.description: The reasoning loops an adaptive turn ran.

next_affinity_token.description: A cache-affinity hint to send with the next turn.

model.description: The model or flow that answered, as requested.

stop_reason.description: Why the reply ended: end_turn, max_tokens, stop_sequence or tool_use.

stop_sequence.description: The stop sequence that ended the reply.

ContentBlockDelta.description: A piece of a content block.

type.description: text_delta carries text; input_json_delta carries part of a tool_use input.

partial_json.description: Part of the tool input's JSON, on an input_json_delta.

stop_sequence.description: The stop sequence that ended the reply.

cached_input_ot.description: The OT charged for cached input.

fresh_input_ot.description: The OT charged for fresh input.

ot_breakdown.description: The OT charged, line by line.

display_money_micros.description: The money amount, in millionths of the display currency.

reservation_id.description: The OT reservation the call settled.

loops_consumed.description: The reasoning loops an adaptive turn ran.

next_affinity_token.description: A cache-affinity hint to send with the next turn.

MessageStartEvent.description: The stream's first event: the reply with no content yet.

ContentBlockStartEvent.description: The start of a content block.

ContentBlockDeltaEvent.description: A piece of a content block, as it arrives.

ContentBlockStopEvent.description: The end of a content block.

MessageDeltaEvent.description: The reply's ending and its usage.

PingEvent.description: An event that keeps the connection open.

ErrorEvent.description: A failure the stream reports after it began.

MessageStreamEvent.description: One server-sent event of a streamed Messages reply. Events of a type not listed here, such as ORBTR's orbtr.ai.* progress events, are passed through with their type and data.

Model.description: A model a call may name.

id.description: The model's id, used as a call's model.

created.description: When the model was added, in Unix seconds.

context_length.description: The context window served, where known.

ModelList.description: The models a call may name.

input.description: The text to embed, or several texts.

dimensions.description: The number of dimensions wanted, where the model can shorten its vectors.

EmbeddingUsage.description: Tokens and OT an embeddings call used.

reservation_id.description: The OT reservation the call settled.

data.description: One vector per input, in input order.

ChatContentPart.description: One part of a chat message's content.

content.description: The message's text, or its parts.

ChatFunctionParam.description: A function the model may call.

parameters.description: The JSON Schema of the function's arguments.

ChatToolParam.description: A tool the model may call.

model.description: A model id from GET /v1/models, or a published flow's id, optionally pinned as <flow id>@<version>.

max_tokens.description: The most tokens the reply may hold.

stop.description: Text that ends the reply when generated.

stream.description: Whether the reply arrives as server-sent events.

ChatCompletionFunctionCall.description: The function a tool call names.

ChatCompletionToolCall.description: A tool call in a reply.

ChatCompletionUsage.description: Tokens and OT a chat call used.

reservation_id.description: The OT reservation the call settled.

created.description: When the reply was made, in Unix seconds.

model.description: The model or flow that answered, as requested.

ChatCompletionChunkFunctionCall.description: Part of a streamed tool call's function.

arguments.description: Part of the arguments' JSON text.

ChatCompletionChunkToolCall.description: Part of a streamed tool call.

ChatCompletionChunkDelta.description: What a chunk adds to the reply.

role.description: The author, on the first chunk.

finish_reason.description: Why the reply ended, on its last chunk.

ChatCompletionChunk.description: One server-sent event of a streamed chat reply.

created.description: When the reply was made, in Unix seconds.

model.description: The model or flow that answered, as requested.

prompt.description: The prompt; several strings are joined by newlines.

max_tokens.description: The most tokens the reply may hold.

stop.description: Text that ends the reply when generated.

stream.description: Whether the reply arrives as server-sent events.

created.description: When the completion was made, in Unix seconds.

CompletionChunk.description: One server-sent event of a streamed completion.

created.description: When the completion was made, in Unix seconds.

custom_id.description: Your id for the request, unique in the batch; its result carries it.

MessageBatchRequestCounts.description: How many of a batch's requests are in each state.

expired.description: Requests that expired before they ran.

cancel_initiated_at.description: When a cancel was asked for (RFC 3339).

results_url.description: Where the batch's results are fetched.

has_more.description: Whether more batches follow the last one.

first_id.description: The first batch's id, to page back from.

last_id.description: The last batch's id; pass it as after_id for the next page.

MessageBatchResultBody.description: How one request of a batch ended.

MessageBatchResult.description: One line of a batch's results.
